ops.oldText: Customer shall not develop, market, sell, or acquire any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory.
ops.newText: Customer may develop, market, sell, or acquire any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory.

ops.oldText: During the term and for twenty-four months thereafter, Customer

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept any restriction on the products or services we develop, buy or sell, so we have flipped the operator in the second § 12.4 into a confirmation that we may compete and dropped the twenty-four-month tail, curing the contradiction with § 12.3. If Cobalt needs protection, we could discuss a narrow term-only restriction on a single named competing product capped at 12 months with carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions.
proposal.summary: Turn the § 12.4 competitive-activity ban into a permission, removing the non-compete and field-of-use restriction on Customer.
